description: Phase 7 Wave 2 — Plan 02: FARO route handler with web search + deep research (gemini-2.5-pro + urlContext). Base branch: ralph/phase-7-merged.

userStories.title: Implement FARO route handler at /api/chat/faro/[projectId] with web search + deep research
userStories.description: As a student, I need to send messages in the FARO tab and receive streamed responses from the FARO course navigator with access to web search for supplemental lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: Route has `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` at top
Route reads `currentSession` and `deepResearch` from POST body (defaults: 1, false)
Route injects session: `const systemWithSession = \`${faroContext}\n\n[Current FUND II Session: ${currentSession} of 10]\``
Route uses `const AGENT_TYPE = 'faro'` as a constant
Standard mode (deepResearch=false): `model: vertex('gemini-2.5-flash')`, tools: `{ google_search: vertex.tools.googleSearch({}) }`
Deep research mode (deepResearch=true): `model: vertex('gemini-2.5-pro')`, tools: `{ google_search: vertex.tools.googleSearch({}), url_context: vertex.tools.urlContext({}) }`

BEFORE using vertex.tools.urlContext({}), check `node_modules/@ai-sdk/google-vertex/dist/index.d.ts` to confirm urlContext is exported from vertex.tools. If not found, implement deep research as model swap only (gemini-2.5-pro + googleSearch, no urlContext) and add a comment: `// urlContext not available in this SDK version`
Route filters message history: `prisma.message.findMany({ where: { projectId, agentType: AGENT_TYPE }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })`
Route persists user and assistant messages with `agentType: AGENT_TYPE`
Route uses the same rolling window logic as Trend Mapper
Route uses the same streaming response headers as Trend Mapper
userStories.notes: Read src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts fully — FARO's route is nearly identical to Trend Mapper's updated route (which already handles deepResearch and currentSession from Phase 5). The key differences: (1) use getFAROContext() instead of getSystemContext(), (2) hardcode AGENT_TYPE = 'faro'. Check the TypeScript type definitions for urlContext before using it.
